posts.title: Taxi from Shoreham-by-Sea to Gatwick Airport: Everything You Need to Know
posts.excerpt: Planning a trip from Shoreham-by-Sea to Gatwick Airport? Here is your complete guide to booking a reliable taxi transfer, what to expect on the journey, and how to get the best fixed fare.

body.text: Gatwick Airport is one of the most popular departure points for travellers from Shoreham-by-Sea and the wider Adur district. Whether you are heading off on a family holiday, a business trip or a city break, getting to Gatwick stress-free starts with choosing the right taxi service.

The journey from Shoreham-by-Sea to Gatwick Airport typically takes around 45 to 60 minutes, depending on traffic conditions on the A23 and M23. We always recommend allowing extra time during peak hours, school holidays and bank holidays when the roads can be busier.

At Western Cars Adur, we offer fixed fares for all Gatwick airport transfers from Shoreham. That means the price you are quoted when you book is exactly what you pay — no surge pricing, no hidden charges, and no meter ticking away while you sit in traffic.

Our drivers monitor your flight in real time. If your outbound flight is delayed or your return flight lands early or late, we adjust your pick-up time accordingly at no extra cost. You will never be left waiting at the terminal.

We cover all Gatwick terminals — North Terminal and South Terminal — and can accommodate saloons, estates, and larger vehicles for groups or passengers with extra luggage. Book online, via our app, or call us 24/7 on 01273473737.

posts.title: Heathrow Airport Transfers from West Sussex: Your Guide to a Smooth Journey
posts.excerpt: Travelling to Heathrow from West Sussex? Discover how to book a reliable private hire transfer, the best routes, and why a fixed-fare taxi beats the train for comfort and convenience.

body.text: Heathrow Airport is the UK's busiest international hub, and for passengers travelling from West Sussex — including Shoreham, Lancing, Worthing and Brighton — a private hire taxi transfer is often the most convenient and cost-effective option.

The drive from Shoreham-by-Sea to Heathrow takes approximately 1 hour 30 minutes to 2 hours depending on traffic. The most common route follows the A27 to the M25, then the M4 into the airport. We recommend booking an early departure to allow for any motorway delays, particularly on Monday mornings and Friday afternoons.

Western Cars Adur serves all five Heathrow terminals: T1, T2, T3, T4 and T5. Our drivers are experienced with Heathrow's drop-off and pick-up zones and will ensure you reach the correct terminal with time to spare.

Compared to travelling by train — which typically requires at least two changes and can take over two hours from Shoreham — a door-to-door taxi transfer is faster, more comfortable, and far easier if you are travelling with luggage, children or elderly passengers.
All our Heathrow fares are fixed and agreed at the time of booking. Call us on 01273473737 or book online for your instant quote. We are available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

posts.title: 5 Tips for Booking an Early Morning Airport Taxi from Shoreham
posts.excerpt: Early morning flights can be stressful. Here are five practical tips to make sure your airport taxi from Shoreham-by-Sea runs smoothly — even when your alarm goes off at 4am.

body.text: Early morning flights are popular because they are often cheaper and less crowded — but they do require careful planning, especially when it comes to your taxi transfer. Here are five tips to help your journey go smoothly.

1. Book in advance. Do not leave your taxi booking until the night before. Book your early morning airport taxi as soon as you have your flight details confirmed. This guarantees your vehicle and driver and avoids any last-minute availability issues.

2. Allow extra time. For a 6am flight from Gatwick, you should aim to be at the airport by 4am at the latest. That means leaving Shoreham around 3am. Always build in a buffer — road works, diversions and unexpected traffic can add time to your journey.

3. Confirm your pick-up the evening before. A quick call or message to your taxi company the night before your early morning pick-up gives you peace of mind and confirms the driver has your booking details correct.

4. Have your luggage ready. Pack the night before and have your bags by the door. The last thing you want at 3am is to be hunting for your passport or trying to fit a suitcase into a bag that is too small.

5. Choose a 24/7 taxi service. Make sure your taxi company genuinely operates around the clock. Western Cars Adur is available 24 hours a day, 365 days a year — including Christmas Day and bank holidays — with no extra charge for unsociable hours. Call us on 01273473737.

posts.title: Travelling with Heavy Luggage? Why a Taxi is the Best Way to the Airport
posts.excerpt: Dragging heavy suitcases onto trains and buses is nobody's idea of a good start to a holiday. Here is why booking a private hire taxi from Shoreham is the smartest choice when you are travelling with luggage.

body.text: If you have ever tried to navigate a busy train station with two large suitcases, a carry-on bag and a child in tow, you will know exactly why so many West Sussex travellers choose a private hire taxi for their airport transfers.

Door-to-door service is the biggest advantage. Your driver picks you up from your home in Shoreham, Lancing, Worthing or wherever you are based, loads your luggage, and drops you directly at your departure terminal. No stairs, no platform changes, no dragging bags through crowded concourses.

Western Cars Adur operates a range of vehicles to suit different luggage requirements. Our saloons and estates are ideal for couples and small families, while our six, seven and eight-seater vehicles are perfect for larger groups or passengers with multiple large cases.

If you are travelling with sports equipment — golf clubs, skis, surfboards or bicycles — please let us know when booking so we can allocate a vehicle with sufficient boot space. We are happy to accommodate unusual luggage requirements with advance notice.
